name: stage2_to_stage3_gate_v3

supersedes.status: frozen and unedited; retained because existing frozen runs reference it
supersedes.chain: v2 superseded configs/stage2_to_stage3_gate_2026-10-18.json, which also remains frozen

amendment_record.what_changed: Requirement 3 only. The sparse 2000-2999 nt band is accepted as a documented limitation rather than resolved by acquisition.
amendment_record.what_did_not_change: The other five requirements, the stage 3 target, and the active length scope bounds. Accepting a limitation does not satisfy, relax or reorder any other requirement.
amendment_record.authorized_by: explicit user instruction on 2026-10-19: 'accept the 2,000-2,999 nt band as a documented limitation'
amendment_record.prior_amendment: v2 amended stage3_target from cell_free_expression to transfected_cell_expression; that amendment stands unchanged.

readouts: firefly luciferase luminescence, time course, for expression
RT-qPCR mRNA time course, for in-cell stability
cell_types_stated: activated CD3+ T cells containing CD4+ and CD8+ populations
stage3_target_detail.note: Cell-free expression is no longer the Stage 3 target. It is not prohibited as future work, but nothing in this project is currently aimed at it.

requirement_3_note: Resolved on 2026-10-19 by accepting the band as a documented limitation. The earlier note that the band was unreachable applied to CLAN coverage only; family-level expansion was available and was not taken. See requirement_3_resolution.

requirement_3_resolution.what_the_limitation_is: The in-scope frozen selection holds 6 records across 3 families and 2 clans. The 2000-2999 nt band contributes exactly 1 record, from family RF02541 in clan CL00112. Its per-band accuracy figure therefore carries no dispersion and no family contrast, and no clan contrast within the band.
requirement_3_resolution.binding_consequence: The full 1 to 2999 nt length range MUST NOT be claimed. Any reported accuracy, coverage or capability statement that spans the 2000-2999 nt band must carry this limitation explicitly. A claim about the band from a single record is not supported.

what_was_available_and_not_taken.family_level_expansion: available: 56 eligible records locally, RF02540 31 and RF02541 25, with RF02540 a family not currently in the selection
what_was_available_and_not_taken.clan_level_expansion: NOT available: the only out-of-baseline band clan CL00004, via family RF02462, is blocked by prior_exposure_overlap on both of its 2 records
what_was_available_and_not_taken.note: Recorded so a later reader knows the band was accepted as a limitation by choice, with family-level expansion available, rather than because nothing could be done. Expanding would have required an explicit gate review and new inference; the census records availability only and authorises no selection.

requirement_3_resolution.reversible: If the band is later expanded by gate review and new inference, this acceptance should be superseded by a further gate version rather than edited.

requirements_satisfied_detail.basis: Satisfied by accepting a documented limitation and narrowing the claim. Coverage of the band did not improve and is still one record.
requirements_satisfied_detail.caution: One requirement satisfied is not progress toward structure accuracy. Nothing about the model changed.

claimed_length_range.rule: The active scope bounds are unchanged; what changed is what may be CLAIMED. The band remains in scope for inference and is excluded from unqualified accuracy claims.
